texte.La communication à l'autorité compétente: Communicating to the competent authority the name, address and contact details, the sector and sub-sector, and the Member States where the entity provides its services.
texte.La comparaison visuelle est l'acte de re: The visual comparison IS the act of review. Insufficient resolution turns the review into a formality.
texte.La conformité du système de management l: Conformity of the management system itself
texte.La conjonction de l'article # du règleme: The combination of article # of Delegated Regulation (EU) #/#, then the three deadlines.
texte.La correspondance avec ISO/IEC # est un: The mapping to ISO/IEC # is the firm's own, built on the subject of each article of the delegated regulation. It is published by no body and binds nobody.
texte.La criticité des services touchés est un: The criticality of the services affected is a GATE, not a seventh threshold: without it, no verdict can be returned.
texte.La culture, les rôles, les politiques et: The culture, the roles, the policies and the processes that decide what is done with AI — and who answers for it.
texte.La destination commande la qualification: The intended purpose governs the high-risk qualification, and therefore everything else. Writing it after the design means deducing it from the product instead of having chosen it.
texte.La destination du système d'IA est-elle: Is the AI system's intended purpose determined and written down?
texte.La direction démontre-t-elle son engagem: Does management demonstrate its commitment through observable acts, and not through a policy statement?
texte.La divulgation à des personnes non autor: The disclosure to unauthorised persons of sensitive information processed by the entity's activities or services
texte.La documentation du SMQ existe-t-elle, e: Does the QMS documentation exist, and does it cover what the standard expects?
texte.La documentation opérationnelle — celle: Is the operational documentation — the kind used to do the work, not to prove it — kept up?
texte.La documentation technique porte-t-elle: Does the technical documentation carry the independence mechanisms implemented, the test results that demonstrate they work, and the configuration options offered to deployers for managing the review flow?
Does the technical documentation carry the seven items the standard sends to it (see the documentation table, derived from your answers)?
texte.La documentation technique, établie avan: The technical documentation, drawn up before placing on the market and kept up to date.
texte.La donnée entre par trois portes — l'ent: Data comes in through three doors — training, retrieved context, the prompt — and mitigating one does not cover the other two.
texte.La durabilité environnementale est-elle: Is environmental sustainability taken into account in the development?
texte.La durée de conservation se règle sur le: The retention period is set by the time needed to identify a harm and attribute it — not by a generic archiving policy.
texte.La décision de revue exige-t-elle une ac: Does the review decision require an explicit action — no passive action counting as a decision — does the system allow observations to be recorded, and does it log the decision, the notes and the timestamp?
texte.La déclaration d'applicabilité ne passe: The statement of applicability does not pass stage #.
The statement of applicability does not pass stage #. The auditor stops at the document: no maturity rate makes up for that defect.
texte.La déclaration ne porte pas les champs s: The declaration does not carry the fields without which no qualification is possible.
texte.La dégradation ou l'interruption, direct: The degradation or interruption, direct or indirect, of the entity's activities or services
texte.La démonstration se fait sur la charge R: The demonstration is made against the REAL expected load, not a theoretical workstation: it is the number of simultaneous scenarios that counts, not the number of screens.
texte.La dépendance des entités financières au: How dependent the financial entities are on the provider's services for their critical or important functions.
texte.La dépendance directe ET indirecte — la: Direct AND indirect dependence — subcontracting is counted, which brings out dependencies no contract shows.
texte.La dépendance du prestataire à l'égard d: The provider's dependence on THE SAME subcontractors for services supporting critical or important functions.
texte.La dérogation microentreprise ne vise QU: The microenterprise derogation covers ONLY point (e) of paragraph #, and only for a microenterprise.
texte.La désignation ouvre un cadre de supervi: The designation opens a European oversight framework, and a fee whose floor is fifty thousand euro a year.
texte.La finalité déclarée ne touche aucun dom: The declared purpose touches none of the areas in the annexes, is not prohibited, and the system neither interacts with people nor produces synthetic content.
texte.La finalité déclarée relève d'un des hui: The declared purpose falls within one of the eight areas of Annex III (biometrics, critical infrastructure, education, employment, essential services and credit, law enforcement, migration, justice and democracy).
texte.La finalité déclarée relève d'une des pr: The declared purpose falls within one of the practices article # prohibits (social scoring, manipulation, emotion recognition at work, predictive policing, untargeted scraping of facial images).
texte.La finalité touche un domaine de l'annex: The purpose touches an Annex III area, but the system performs only a narrow procedural task, or improves human work already done, without replacing human judgement. The derogation must be documented before placing on the market (art. #(#)).
texte.La formation du personnel est un encoura: Staff training is an encouragement: it is displayed, but the block validates without it.
texte.La formation ne vise pas que le comité d: The training does not target the management committee alone: the people EXPOSED to the risk are named there on an equal footing.
texte.La forme est imposée. Un envoi complet m: The form is prescribed. A complete but badly structured submission is a submission to do again.
texte.La gestion des ressources, y compris la: Resource management, including security of supply.
texte.La justification de votre impossibilité: The justification for your inability to implement these alerts must appear in the technical documentation, with a reference to the reaction time.
The justification for your inability to implement real-time alerts, with a reference to the reaction time
texte.La justification des mesures retenues: The justification of the measures chosen
texte.La justification s'appuie sur une analys: The justification rests on a risk analysis. Without one, the exclusion is not admissible.
texte.La latence d'intervention déclarée dépas: The declared intervention latency exceeds the reaction time. Human oversight is not, for this scenario, a risk-management measure: raise the category of measure, or apply #.
texte.La latence d'intervention déclarée est i: The declared intervention latency is less than or equal to the reaction time determined for this scenario.
texte.La latence dépasse le délai et aucune co: The latency exceeds the deadline and no record under # is declared. This is the case the standard refuses: an oversight assignment with no capacity to intervene is not a measure.
texte.La ligne de prEN #-# est intitulée « Cré: The prEN #-# row is titled « Trustworthiness Part # » — the same wording as the previous row, which really is part #.
The register row cannot be read.
texte.La liste des conditions NON réversibles: The list of NON-reversible conditions is the part that counts: a transfer executed and an email sent cannot be taken back, and the designated person must know it before acting.
texte.La liste des dix risques et leurs intitu: The list of the ten risks and their # titles.
texte.La liste des prestataires désignés criti: The list of providers designated critical is not reproduced. It is published by the Joint Committee and updated each year; copying it here would guarantee that it is wrong one day with nothing to say so.
texte.La liste des prestataires tiers de servi: The list of third-party ICT service providers designated critical.
texte.La mesure ne tient pas le délai: The measure does not hold the deadline
texte.La mise en œuvre suppose de détenir le p: Implementing it assumes you hold the draft standard, which is obtained from a national member of CEN (AFNOR in France); at the Enquiry stage, it is circulated for comment.
texte.La mise en œuvre suppose de détenir le t: Implementing it assumes you hold the text of the standard, which is bought from ISO or from a national standards body (AFNOR in France).
texte.La norme adresse ses exigences au fourni: The standard addresses its requirements to the provider and passes them to the deployer through the instructions: the questionnaire, the locks and the score depend on the role.
texte.La norme ne vous adresse pas directement: The standard does not address its requirements to you directly: it addresses them to your provider. What falls to you arrives through the instructions for use — and that is precisely what this framework lets you DEMAND of a provider, and then implement.
texte.La norme vous adresse ses exigences. Ell: The standard addresses its requirements to you. They bear on design and development: the oversight measures themselves, their verification, and the information you pass on to the deployer.
texte.La notice d'utilisation dit-elle quels r: Do the instructions for use say which residual risks remain even where the deployer's measures are correctly implemented, and what conditions or limitations apply to use where they are not?
texte.La notice d'utilisation définit-elle les: Do the instructions for use define the reviewers' minimum competences and training — being able to use the interface, being able to read a confidence score and a quality indicator, being warned about automation bias — and do they recommend training content?
texte.La notice d'utilisation est-elle produit: Are the instructions for use produced, and do they carry what the deployer needs to know in order to meet its own obligations?
texte.La notice d'utilisation porte-t-elle les: Do the instructions for use carry the seven pieces of oversight information the standard sends to them (see the documentation table, derived from your answers)?
texte.La notice est le seul véhicule par leque: The instructions are the only vehicle through which the deployment-dependent obligations pass to the deployer. What they do not say is left with nobody carrying it.
texte.La part « stratégie » n'est comptée qu'à: The « strategy » share is counted at only half: the documentation work is real, it is the DEMONSTRATION that is missing. The detail is on the « Process » screen.
texte.La partie est rétablie d'après la référe: The part is restored from the reference itself (prEN #-#) and from the article addressed (#). The original wording is recalled on screen.
texte.La personne désignée a un accès continu: The designated person has continuous, real-time access to the state of the system, to its outputs, to its alerts and to the availability of the intervention functions.
texte.La personne désignée a-t-elle un accès c: Does the designated person have continuous, real-time access to the system's current operation and to its alerts — and do they know at any moment whether they can still override an output, shut the system down or reset it?
texte.La personne désignée annule une action D: The designated person undoes an action ALREADY EXECUTED and brings the process back to an earlier or safe state.
texte.La personne désignée bloque la sortie du: The designated person blocks the system's output and substitutes an alternative of their own; the automatic path is interrupted.
texte.La personne désignée dispose-t-elle d'un: Does the designated person have a safe-state control — a hardware button or a software command — reachable INDEPENDENTLY of the system, and is the transition validated on time, stability, completeness of mitigation and recovery?
texte.La personne désignée déclenche un état s: The designated person triggers a predefined safe state — or a shutdown, where shutdown is itself a safe state — through a trigger reachable independently of the system's state.
texte.La personne désignée peut-elle annuler u: Can the designated person undo an action ALREADY executed and bring the process back to an earlier or safe state, do the dependent processes receive the order to revert as well, and do the instructions say what is reversible and what is not?
texte.La personne désignée rejette expliciteme: The designated person explicitly rejects an output BEFORE it is executed; the system neither executes it nor replays it.
texte.La politique qualité, les rôles, et qui: The quality policy, the roles, and who answers for what.
texte.La politique qui tranche un désaccord en: The policy that settles a disagreement between reviewers belongs to the system owner: it must be defined and documented, not improvised.
texte.La preuve objective que l'exigence est s: Objective evidence that the requirement is satisfied
texte.La proportionnalité tient compte du degr: Proportionality takes account of the degree of exposure, the entity's size, and the likelihood and severity of incidents.
texte.La protection des données se conçoit ava: Data protection is designed before go-live, not after.
texte.La présence de données biométriques ou s: The presence of biometric or sensitive data shifts the qualification, and the GDPR is added on top.
texte.La présentation des sorties et des indic: Presenting the outputs and the confidence indicators comes under prEN #-#: this clause deals only with the oversight functions.
texte.La prévention est technique chez le four: The prevention is technical, at the provider's end; the assignment is organisational, at yours. Both are needed.
texte.La qualification, les cinq composantes d: The qualification, the five components of the §# strategy, and the approach chosen for each of the seven essential requirements.
texte.La qualité rédactionnelle fait présumer: Good writing makes correctness presumed: the better the text reads, the less it gets re-read.
texte.La responsabilité NOMMÉE et personnelle: The NAMED, personal responsibility of the management body for the ICT risk management framework. Control A.# asks for a commitment; the Regulation designates someone accountable.
texte.La revue de direction : elle ne produit: The management review: it produces nothing by itself, it decides on what the rest produces.
texte.La revue de direction, l'amélioration, e: The management review, improvement, and the planning of changes to the management system.
texte.La revue produit-elle des décisions trac: Does the review produce decisions on the record, and not just minutes?
texte.La revue reçoit-elle ce qu'il lui faut p: Does the review receive what it needs in order to decide — monitoring, incidents, nonconformities, changes, feedback from deployers?
texte.La réponse du moteur n'est pas un objet: The engine's reply is not a usable JSON object.
texte.La révision # (#) parle d'ICS et surchar: Revision # (#) speaks of ICS and overlays #-# Rev. #. Revision # (#) speaks of OT and targets revision #.
texte.La révision # ajoute les familles PT et: Revision # adds the PT and SR families and renames CA. A system already aligned on revision # reads this rate against an edition older than its own.
texte.La seconde moitié s'oublie : ce qui se p: The second half gets forgotten: what happens if the measure is NOT implemented has to be written down, otherwise the system is used outside its intended purpose with nobody knowing.
texte.La sensibilisation au biais d'automatisa: Awareness of automation bias is expressly listed among the competences: on a flow of thousands of identifications, it is the first risk.
texte.La seule fiche disponible à ce jour — ar: The only sheet available to date — secure architectures, objectives # and # — and the confirmation that the collection is neither prescriptive nor exhaustive.
texte.La seule qui soit un préalable : un syst: The only one that is a precondition: a system that does not work has no need to be fair.
texte.La sortie doit rester isolée pendant la: The output must stay isolated during the review: if downstream systems can read it « for information », it is not isolated.
texte.La sortie du modèle est reprise telle qu: The model's output is taken as it stands by the downstream system — a query, a command, a rendered page — without being treated as untrusted input.
texte.La sous-traitance est dans l'obligation,: Subcontracting is inside the obligation, not beside it: a provider who operates the system does not move the responsibility.
texte.La stratégie de conformité réglementaire: Is the regulatory compliance strategy determined and documented, with its five components?
texte.La stratégie de gestion des données est-: Is the data management strategy established and kept up?
texte.La stratégie de respect de la réglementa: The regulatory compliance strategy, including for modifications.
texte.La supervision se dégrade par la fatigue: Oversight degrades through fatigue, falling vigilance and competing demands on attention long before it degrades through a design fault.
texte.La surveillance après commercialisation: Post-market monitoring by providers, and the plan that goes with it.
texte.La surveillance de l'autorité compétente: Supervision by the competent authority — the ACPR or the AMF in France. An accredited body certifies a management system; it issues no compliance with a regulation.
The size is not filled in.
texte.La taille ne décide PAS du régime. Une m: Size does NOT decide the regime. A microenterprise that is in none of the five categories of article #(#) falls under the full framework.
texte.La transmission des notifications d'inci: The forwarding of incident notifications to the CSIRTs or authorities designated under NIS #, where the Member State so decides.
texte.La validation démontre-t-elle que le sys: Does the validation demonstrate that the system meets its intended purpose under real conditions of use?
